title: Use val_to_str_const() where unknown string doesn't have format specifier
description: There are more, not sure if its worth scripting a quick check.

notes.body:
added 2 commits

  • 16a6eef9 - Use val_to_str_const() where unknown string doesn't have format specifier
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/10343/diffs?diff_id=657817836&start_sha=1d12effa8f70bf944dd77f3472d5a5e65fec2a12)
enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for 16a6eef95b1abb554fcc7ea6eebb5b5090e56c9e succeeds

`epan/dissectors/packet-ilp.c` is a generated file, so `epan/dissectors/asn1/ilp.cnf` needed to be changed (and `epan/dissectors/packet-ilp.c` then regenerated from the changed source), rather than being edited directly.

Fixed in !10352.
